```plato
    // The spacing between adjacent lattice nodes along each axis: the sampling
    // resolution, and the scale of the interpolation error.
    NodeSpacing(self: SampledSdf2D): Vector2D
        => (
            (self.Bounds.Max.X - self.Bounds.Min.X) / (self.Values.ColumnCount - 1).ToNumber,
            (self.Bounds.Max.Y - self.Bounds.Min.Y) / (self.Values.RowCount - 1).ToNumber);
```

```plato
    // The spacing between adjacent lattice nodes along each axis.
    NodeSpacing(self: SampledSdf3D): Vector3D
        => (
            (self.Bounds.Max.X - self.Bounds.Min.X) / (self.Values.ColumnCount - 1).ToNumber,
            (self.Bounds.Max.Y - self.Bounds.Min.Y) / (self.Values.RowCount - 1).ToNumber,
            (self.Bounds.Max.Z - self.Bounds.Min.Z) / (self.Values.LayerCount - 1).ToNumber);
```
